children.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity and Affective Engagement

detail.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity and Affective Engagement
detail.summary: Curiosity functions as a critical driver for active learning by targeting information gaps, while generative technologies can support these processes by enhancing learner autonomy and positive affective states, aligning with self-determination theory.
detail.reason: Synthesis of existing evidence demonstrates alignment between curiosity-driven information-seeking and positive affective learning states.
